scope: Both individual principal Belvedere palaces: the complete Upper palace with three raised mansard-roofed central blocks and four domed corner pavilions, and the complete Lower palace with raised central hall, red hipped/mansard roofs and its actual bent rear courtyard ranges. Gardens, ponds, detached annexes and city buildings remain native context. Original exterior geometry; no interiors or copied sculpture.
heightPolicy: Picture-guided relative palace heights on an approximate182m standard Terrarium reference. Upper threshold194m (pool front195.7m), Lower threshold173.3m. Separate occupied foundations and bounded entry transitions meet the unchanged coarse field; no garden flattening. Lower native central height28m is inconsistent with its photographed one-story frontage/raised hall and is not treated as a surveyed dimension. Historic thresholds and roof heights remain approximate.
limitations: Fine ornaments, window inventories, concealed roof joins and historic grade are original approximations. No copied statues, heraldry or inscriptions. The coarse global elevation field is not surveyed; bounded thresholds approximate contact, not historic stairs. Physical-device timings and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured.
